name: agent-os-workbench
description: Open Olivia's Agent Switch beside your VS Code projects.

chatParticipants.name: agentos
chatParticipants.description: Run this task through your locally signed-in Codex or Claude Code CLI account.

commands.name: auto
commands.description: Let Agent OS choose an agent and use its configured backup.

commands.name: codex
commands.description: Run this task with Codex, with Agent OS backup routing.

commands.name: claude
commands.description: Run this task with Claude Code, with Agent OS backup routing.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Start a new Agent OS project and conversation.

agentOS.projectPath.description: Path to the local Olivia's Agent Switch source folder (the folder containing scripts/start-codex-dashboard.mjs). Defaults to the first open VS Code workspace folder.

agentOS.dashboardUrl.description: Local Olivia's Agent Switch dashboard URL. Keep this on loopback; it exposes local agent tools and files.

agentOS.autoStart.description: Start the local dashboard if it is not already running.

agentOS.backupProvider.description: Preferred backup agent for @agentos. Automatic routing avoids handing a task back to its current provider.
